focus: The status page can now report its own degradation: it shows the open edge incident, how long it has been running, and which feed proves it. Durations are stated as observation-bounded upper bounds, never as claimed start times.
nextStep: Next we are reconciling the held Supabase runtime updates and completing real-provider identity proofs before a manually confirmed production promotion, then confirming the edge incident closes cleanly on the status page.
